summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted, file-backed volume on node1 (RHEL 10) that auto-unlocks and mounts at /srv/secure on every boot, no manual passphrase entry required. Restarted node1 once and verified the volume re-mounted itself with data intact.
actions_performed: Provisioned a 1G file-backed LUKS2 container at /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img, keyed with a root-only 4KB random keyfile at /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key (chmod 600)
Formatted the mapped device with XFS and mounted it at /srv/secure

Added an /etc/crypttab entry (secure /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key luks,nofail) referencing the file path directly (UUID= does not apply to file-backed containers, which lack a udev by-uuid symlink)
Verified systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service activates and mount -a succeeds without manual intervention
Captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active crypt unit, mounted fs, a written healthcheck file) before restart
Issued a native systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot_id after restart (proof of an actual reboot, not just service restart)
Confirmed post-restart the crypttab/fstab entries auto-unlocked and mounted /srv/secure with the pre-reboot healthcheck file intact, proving unattended boot-time recovery

evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume created and mounted at /srv/secure
evidence.summary: LUKS2 luksFormat/luksOpen/mkfs.xfs succeeded; mount -a mounted /dev/mapper/secure at /srv/secure and a test file was written and read back
crypttab entry references the file-backed container by path with a keyfile; systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service activated purely from this crypttab entry (no manual cryptsetup invocation)
Recorded boot_id f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c, active crypt service, mounted /srv/secure with healthcheck.txt present
systemctl reboot issued asynchronously; command stream closed as the node went down, confirming the reboot was accepted

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c to 4dea6efc-e65a-4468-ba57-19cfdefd1058 after exec access returned

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of encrypted volume and data verified
evidence.summary: systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service active, /dev/mapper/secure mounted at /srv/secure, and the pre-reboot healthcheck.txt content matches exactly — proving unattended unlock and mount at boot
